biotools.summary: MIND4OLIGOS is a Shiny application that predicts the monoisotopic mass of oligonucleotides observed in high-resolution mass spectrometry. It adapts the MIND algorithm for use with oligonucleotide data, enabling more accurate annotation of complex spectra.
